== Summary ==
Decipher staff at the Decipher booth, Comic-Con 2001, in front of a ''The Lord of the Rings'' banner. From left to right, as the source caption names them: [[Sean Smallman]] (Star Trek and small convention promotions), [[Jon Snyder]] (VP Fan Club Operations), [[Kevin Reitzel]] (Product Champion Coordinator) and [[Kyle Heuer]] (Promotions Coordinator).

* '''Source:''' [http://www.theonering.net/movie/scrapbook/large/1536 Comic-Con 2001: Decipher], TheOneRing.net scrapbook (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010805025951/http://www.theonering.net:80/movie/scrapbook/large/1536 Internet Archive] (5 August 2001). Image: [https://web.archive.org/web/20241130013749id_/http://img-www.theonering.net/images/scrapbook/1536.jpg 1536.jpg] (Wayback SHA-1 matches this file). Uploaded unchanged.
* '''Photographer:''' unknown (TheOneRing.net scrapbook, source "Comic-Con 2001").
* '''Date:''' 19 July 2001 (camera date stamp); Comic-Con International, San Diego.
* '''Identification:''' Caption on the source page: "From L to R: Sean Smallman (Star Trek and small convention promotions), Jon Snyder (VP Fan Club Operations), Kevin Reitzel (Product Champion Coordinator), Kyle Heuer (Promotions Coordinator)". Far left, black shirt and glasses: Sean Smallman. Second, white shirt with shoulder bag: Jon Snyder. Third, black shirt and goatee: Kevin Reitzel. Far right, black shirt and white trousers: Kyle Heuer.

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a 640 by 480 convention snapshot published by TheOneRing.net in 2001, used only to identify Decipher staff on their articles on a non-commercial fan wiki. No free photograph of these people at Decipher is known, and the low-resolution copy cannot harm any market for the original.

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-5/59/Decipher_staff_Comic-Con_2001.jpg Internet Archive item].
